children: NVIDIA to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9–13.0B, ~$11.9B to investors plus up to $1B in retention equity; deal expected to close H1 2027, per regulatory filings.
NVIDIA (NVDA) dominates AI compute with >80% market share in AI hardware. It aims to set future compute pricing and is tied to a proposed $500B customer financing plan.
NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin platform will be deployed at Nscale’s Barstow data center in H2 2027; deployment may scale to large GPU capacity and Nscale becomes Figure’s preferred compute partner.
NVIDIA (NVDA) in June launched RTX Spark, pairing a Blackwell GPU with a Grace CPU. Built with Microsoft and MediaTek, the system targets AI-ready PCs—key for traders tracking NVDA product momentum.
NVIDIA launched PAIR, an open-source tool that links RTX GPUs, DGX Spark and Apple devices on a local network to share idle compute for AI agents, auto-managing devices and speeding task completion.
Bank of America kept a Buy on NVIDIA (NVDA) after investor-relations meetings, keeping it its top sector pick while flagging concerns about memory and circular financing discussed with management.
NVIDIA (NVDA) co-published an 800V DC white paper with Google and Microsoft in March 2026 and backed an LVDC solid‑state transformer spec in July 2026; 80+ manufacturers are building to it.
